description: Address 5 issues from code review: token leakage in verbose mode, temp file leak on early exit, single-layer mode skips auth, JSON export injection, and set -u empty array compatibility.
steps: Fix issue 1: Redact bearer tokens from verbose curl command logging
Fix issue 2: Use trap-based cleanup for temp files in perform_request and perform_stream_request
Fix issue 3: Auto-run layer 4 auth when single-layer mode targets layers 5-18 and AUTH_TOKEN is empty but credentials are available
Fix issue 4: Replace cat-heredoc JSON export with jq-based generation to prevent injection
Fix issue 5: Fix empty array expansion for bash < 4.4 compatibility with set -u
acceptance_criteria: Bearer tokens are redacted from verbose output
Temp files are cleaned up even on early exit
Single-layer mode auto-runs auth when credentials are available
JSON export uses jq for safe output
Script works with bash < 4.4 without unbound variable errors
